title: Teacher Lesson Access – One teacher with 100 lessons – Recovery completes with 100 unique lesson permissions
description: AC-07 — Boundary Value Analysis, Regression — High-volume single teacher.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
Teacher Contact N is assigned to exactly 100 lessons.
Teacher Contact N has no Salesforce User.
None of the 100 lessons has a teacher permission for Teacher Contact N.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff creates an active Salesforce User linked to Teacher Contact N."
2. "HQ or CM Staff counts teacher permissions for the 100 assigned lessons."
steps_result:
1. "One recovery flow reaches completed status without a limit error."
2. "Exactly 100 unique Edit permissions exist for Teacher N."
steps_data:
1. "Lesson assignment count = 100; User status = Active"
2. "Expected permission count = 100; Duplicate count = 0"

title: Teacher Lesson Access – 100 teachers with 100 lessons each – Recovery workload – Complete unique permissions are created
description: AC-07 — Boundary Value Analysis, Regression — 100 × 100 stress workload.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
100 teacher Contacts are each assigned to exactly 100 lessons.
The 100 corresponding Salesforce Users do not exist before recovery.
No assignment has a teacher permission before recovery starts.
Background recovery monitoring is enabled.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff creates or activates the 100 Salesforce Users."
2. "HQ or CM Staff waits for recovery flows to finish and counts teacher permissions."
3. "HQ or CM Staff samples the first middle and last teachers in Back Office."
steps_result:
1. "Each eligible teacher has one recovery flow and no flow ends in Failed status."
2. "Exactly 10000 unique Edit permissions exist."
3. "Each sampled teacher sees 100 assigned lessons and no sampled teacher's lessons."
steps_data:
1. "User count = 100; Lessons per user = 100; Total assignments = 10000"
2. "Expected permission count = 10000; Duplicate count = 0; Failed request count = 0"
3. "Sample users = P-001 P-050 P-100; Expected lessons per sample = 100"
